reference.environment: sealed empty vacuum cavity; ideal-conductor electrostatic baseline
reference.status: analytical scale estimates only; M3a.3 numerical NO-GO for extended trajectories

effects.class: include in later coupled model; compare direct-no-particle baseline
effects.model: one-sided classical Sv=4 k_B T Re(Z); quantum symmetrized Sv=2 ħω Re(Z)coth(ħω/2kBT) under stated convention
effects.evidence: Established fluctuation-dissipation physics; NIST Johnson-noise thermometry
effects.scale: proportional to T Re(Z) classically; receiver transfer and bandwidth required
effects.reference_estimate: 300 K, 1 kΩ gives sqrt(Sv)=4.07 nV/sqrt(Hz) in classical limit
effects.uncertainty: actual complex port impedance, temperatures, filtering, correlations unknown
effects.neglect_condition: only if measured/inferred receiver PSD is below another independently bounded source throughout analysis band
effects.next_model: lumped then measured-port noise; compare directly with particle-free CMOS noise

effects.model: measured S_E(ω,T,d) or explicit fluctuator/adsorbate model; heating n_dot=e² S_E/(4m ħω) for stated single-sided convention, negligible micromotion
effects.dimensionless: distance d/r0; spectral exponent α; ħω/kBT
effects.evidence: ion-trap heating measurements show material, preparation, distance and temperature dependence; no universal law
effects.scale: often parameterized S_E∝ω^-α d^-β T^γ, exponents are empirical not universal
effects.reference_estimate: cannot assign defensible magnitude to this unbuilt silicon surface
effects.uncertainty: surface chemistry, oxide, adsorbates, charge kinetics, fabrication history
effects.neglect_condition: only after applicable device measurement bounds noise-induced heating and force below budgets
effects.next_model: sensitivity model over measured PSD bounds, then surface-specific experiment/data

effects.class: later comparison only; vacuum is primary
effects.model: Poisson impacts plus species-specific differential scattering, charge exchange and charge-changing loss; Langevin only when its regime assumptions hold
effects.evidence: established gas kinetics and ion mobility; collision dynamics are species/potential dependent
effects.scale: rate scales with pressure and collision cross section; not simply damping for all energies
effects.reference_estimate: ambient operation is implausible for secular trapping; residual-gas rate awaits pressure and species
effects.uncertainty: sealed cavity pressure, residual composition, cross sections
effects.neglect_condition: Γ_loss × required service interval ≪ allowed loss probability with validated model
effects.next_model: later pressure/lifetime budget; no collisions in current deterministic M3a

effects.class: include in later nanoscale coupled electrostatics
effects.model: perfect grounded plane U=-Q²/(16π ε0 d); full geometry requires boundary-value solution
effects.evidence: classical conductor image charge; silicon/dielectric response differs from perfect conductor
effects.scale: 1/d and independent of mass at fixed Q
effects.reference_estimate: 0.36 meV at d=1µm; 3.6meV at 100nm, planar idealization
effects.uncertainty: surface distance, finite conductivity, dielectric stack, charge state
effects.neglect_condition: |U_image| and gradient << measured/validated confinement margin over entire accessible region
effects.next_model: include via boundary element or FEM with validated material stack

effects.class: essential for later physical device model
effects.model: full time-dependent RF plus measured amplitude/phase/frequency-noise spectra and excess micromotion
effects.scale: RF fields ∝V/r0; secular frequency and micromotion depend on q and displacement
effects.reference_estimate: ideal scenario A Ca+: fRF≈2.47GHz at 1µm, 10Vdiff peak, q=.2; finite FEM remains uncertain
effects.uncertainty: finite-geometry forces, RF phase noise, port loading
effects.neglect_condition: only if RF noise sideband heating and excess micromotion are below quantified margins
effects.next_model: after PDE force gate, full-RF deterministic + measured spectra

effects.model: pressure-dependent collision, charge exchange, chemical neutralization, desorption and escape hazard
effects.evidence: vacuum ion traps and sealed microcavity packaging demonstrated at macroscale relative to chip
effects.scale: service survival decreases with pressure and exposure time
effects.reference_estimate: not inferable without package leak/outgassing and gas composition
effects.neglect_condition: upper-bounded integrated loss probability below an application-selected requirement
effects.next_model: package pressure evolution and Poisson reliability analysis

effects.model: surface-enhanced field, Fowler–Nordheim emission plus material-specific breakdown statistics
effects.evidence: established emission physics, but β_field and vacuum surface strength depend strongly on processing
effects.scale: nominal field V/r0 rises on shrinking geometry at fixed voltage
effects.reference_estimate: 10MV/m nominal at 1µm in ideal scale case; not an emission prediction
effects.uncertainty: edge radius, contamination, silicon doping, oxide, gap statistics
effects.neglect_condition: only if measured process-specific emission/leakage bounds meet RF drive budget
effects.next_model: field enhancement from curved FEM/CAD followed by process data

effects.class: unresolved technology-dependent; later RF loss model
effects.model: frequency-dependent complex conductivity/Drude or measured wafer impedance, Joule loss
effects.evidence: known semiconductor transport; trap performance depends on resistivity and frequency
effects.scale: GHz–hundreds GHz can invalidate low-frequency local-conductivity assumptions
effects.uncertainty: doping, temperature, depletion, contacts, surface states
effects.neglect_condition: only if measured RF loss and voltage transfer are negligible within power/stability budget
effects.next_model: characterize wafer stack then RF/full-wave solver

effects.class: unresolved; include when material stack specified
effects.model: complex permittivity, dielectric loss tangent, trapped-charge dynamics
effects.dimensionless: tanδ; ε_r geometry ratio; charge relaxation time × ω
effects.evidence: surface ion-trap literature reports dielectric charging/loss sensitivity
effects.scale: thermal loss ∝ω C V² tanδ; charging drift depends on process/history
effects.reference_estimate: not assigned absent stack and oxide data
effects.neglect_condition: measured loss/field drift below budgets across specified environment
effects.next_model: material characterization and dielectric boundary FEM

effects.model: as-built CAD perturbations, rounded edges and measured roughness spectrum
effects.scale: relative errors grow as dimensions shrink at fixed absolute tolerance
effects.uncertainty: etch bias, sidewall taper, alignment, roughness PSD
effects.neglect_condition: only if tolerance propagation to force and field is below numerical/physical budget

effects.model: thermoelastic geometry drift and mechanical acceleration/displacement spectra
effects.evidence: standard MEMS thermo-mechanics; no package-specific data
effects.reference_estimate: cannot quantify without package stack and mounting
effects.uncertainty: CTE, stress, vibration spectrum, RF drive heating
effects.neglect_condition: bounded displacements and fields far below stability margins
effects.next_model: coupled thermal/mechanical model after device stack definition

effects.class: negligible in electrostatic single-ion baseline only under bounds; later species check
effects.model: Lorentz force Q v×B; Zeeman structure for state-sensitive readout
effects.scale: electron cyclotron response particularly sensitive; ion trajectory correction often small
effects.reference_estimate: no B field specified; no numerical correction asserted
effects.neglect_condition: ratio of magnetic to electric restoring force ≪ specified tolerance
effects.next_model: field map + Lorentz term if candidate/readout is B-sensitive

effects.class: include later if classicality parameter fails
effects.model: ħω/(kBT), x_zpf/r0, tunneling through computed finite barrier
effects.evidence: standard harmonic quantum mechanics; no nanoscale trap prediction yet
effects.scale: quantum effects increase at high frequency/small mass; tunneling geometry-dependent
effects.reference_estimate: Ca+ axial 1MHz x_zpf≈11nm; at r0=1µm this is small, but thermal RMS at 300K is ≈40µm
effects.uncertainty: actual finite-depth potential and RF Floquet quantum model
effects.neglect_condition: occupation≫1 and tunneling probability negligible over defined horizon
effects.next_model: quantum harmonic/Floquet treatment only after finite potential validation

effects.model: Shockley–Ramo weighting field, port impedance, FDT noise, reciprocal damping and measurement backaction
effects.evidence: image current detection established in ion and electron traps; not this chip geometry
effects.scale: sensitivity-bandwidth tradeoff; high Q narrows response and cools motion
effects.reference_estimate: conditional g_eff=0.4/r0 gives Ca+ 1mK current tens of fA at 1µm; not validated 3D receiver
effects.uncertainty: differential weighting gradient, capacitance, Q, parasitics, RF leakage
effects.neglect_condition: cannot neglect for entropy or readout claims
effects.next_model: 3D weighting + measured/literature-bounded receiver; matched particle-free baseline

effects.model: cooling rate vs heating, source capture/ionization/loading, vacuum pressure evolution, receiver/RF dissipation and recovery duty
effects.dimensionless: Γ_cool/Γ_heat; loading time/service time; P_module/energy per bit
effects.evidence: discrete ion traps and sealed vacuum packages exist at larger scales; integrated sources exist as component demonstrations
effects.scale: auxiliary systems may dominate footprint and energy
effects.reference_estimate: no complete module budget is available
effects.uncertainty: loading efficiency, CMOS RF efficiency, package leak/outgassing, amplifier power
effects.next_model: system architecture and bounded measured component budgets
